versions.content: Two ways to use the ExclusiveArea s There are in general two ways to use the ExclusiveArea s. During its execution, a RunnableEntity can enter and exit an ExclusiveArea (in which case ExecutableEntity . canEnter shall exist). As an alternative, it can be specified that the entire execution of a given RunnableEn- tity shall be guarded by an ExclusiveArea (this requires the existence of Exe- cutableEntity . runsInside ).
